readerCopy.body: An old hurt can feel immediate again because the response built around it is still familiar. Chiron conjunct the South Node can bring a wound, insecurity, or protective habit back into focus at the exact place where you have learned how to function around it. You may minimize the need, over-prepare, become useful, or avoid the same exposure because those strategies once kept the tender spot manageable. The skill you developed is real. You do not have to keep reopening the injury to justify having it.
